title: deps(v18): resolve @objectstack/* 18.0.0-next.3 and follow its contract (objectui#12873)
body:
Fixes #12873
Clause-②: yes

Moves objectui's lockfile from `@objectstack/*` `18.0.0-next.2` to `18.0.0-next.3`, and follows the contract changes in that release that reach objectui. npm `next` is `18.0.0-next.3`, built from objectstack `2c9bf9430a`: the `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` and `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.3` tags both peel to it. The upstream range is `e5136ff10f..2c9bf9430a` (158 commits).

## Versions moved

- **Lockfile.** objectui resolves seven `@objectstack/*` packages: `client`, `core`, `formula`, `lint`, `sdui-parser`, `spec` and `types`. All seven were published at `18.0.0-next.3`, and all fourteen lockfile entries (two per package) now resolve there; none stays at `next.2`. The lockfile was regenerated by pnpm only (`pnpm -r up --no-save '@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.3'`). No other resolution moved: the lockfile diff is 72 lines out and 72 in, all `@objectstack/*`. `check:lockfile-integrity` and `check:lockfile-dedupe` are green.
- **Range floors.** None moved. No held card needs `next.3` in a range, and `check:spec-floors` is green with the floors as they are: `^18.0.0-next.2` on `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, `^18.0.0-next.1` everywhere else.
- **`e2e/live/ci/backend.env`** names `18.0.0-next.3`. Following `start-backend.sh`'s instruction to re-measure at every pin bump, its `vitest` override was checked on `next.3` under npm 10.9.4, with a fresh cache and the showcase app at `2c9bf9430a`. Without the override, the install still dies with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`. With it (`~4.0.0`), it exits 0 and installs `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.3`. So the override stays.

## Reds after the bump, the upstream commit behind each, and what this PR did

Measured with the full suite in 16 shards (5,424 files), plus a re-run of every pin this PR touches as it stands at BASE, on `2e80918` (lockfile only, `next.3` installed): 9 red files, 36 red tests.

| red | upstream commit | what this PR did |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: 22 forward-direction cases plus the node-level derivation pin | objectstack `105902f` (the page component's `visibility` fold leaves the load path, so `PageComponentSchema` is no longer a `.pipe()`) | contract-following: the node-level key set reads the schema's own shape instead of `_def.in` |
| `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: 3 unpublished-key exemption cases | objectstack `ae0ca66` (`page:header` `showStar` tombstoned) | contract-following: deleted the `page:header.showStar` exemption, which says in its own text that it dies on this bump |
| `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: 2 population cases | objectstack `97b8e7a51d` (`record:json`) | contract-following: ledgered as NOT REGISTERED, DELIBERATELY (see objectui#12490 below); the population moves from 59 to 60 |
| `recordDetailsInputs`, `recordHighlightsInputs`, `recordRelatedListInputs` spec-parity (4 cases) | objectstack `105902f` | contract-following: the same shape read as the repo-wide gate |
| `select-option-spec-extension-7014` key-set pin | objectstack `adad73f` (select option `kind`) | contract-following: seven keys; `select-option.ts` names `kind` among the inherited keys, as the pin asks |
| `block-config` palette coverage | objectstack `97b8e7a51d` | contract-following: a `PALETTE_EXCLUSIONS` entry for `record:json` |
| `check-lockfile-integrity` samples | the bump itself | samples re-keyed onto the `next.3` snapshot keys |
| `ci-cd-pipeline-doc` live-e2e pin | the bump itself | `backend.env` moved |
| `check-installed-spec-pin-claims` (26 sites, 38 lines) | the bump itself | re-measured and restamped (see below) |

No red was left for a follow-up card.

**Re-measured stamps.** Each fact beside a `next.2` stamp was re-measured on `next.3`, with `next.2` as the control, before its stamp moved:
- a parse probe over both installed spec builds and both lint builds. Its output was identical except for the view-data page check;
- the green type-check for the type-level readings;
- the files' own tests.

Three sentences were rewritten rather than restamped, because their fact moved:
- `spec-object-refinements-7715` (2 sites) and `page-component-view-data-12666` said the installed spec still carries `checkPageComponentViewData`. `next.3` is the first release without it (objectstack `a35f7a6`), and on `next.3` the spec's `PageSchema` accepts a slotted `api` binding, as objectui's page node already did.
- `ci-cd-pipeline.md` held a one-off `next.2` reading in which the verb "installed" was read as an installed-pin claim. It is reworded with the same meaning.

## Held cards

| card | reading on `next.3` | where |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectui#12490 | The installed release carries objectstack `97b8e7a51d`: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 97b8e7a51d 2c9bf9430a` exits 0, and the installed spec exports `RecordJsonProps` and a `record:json` row. Since the card was held, the maintainer dropped this face (pointer 6232139151 on the card). No renderer is to be built, and the type is filed for retirement upstream (objectstack#24162). | Not built here. The two places `next.3` forced a decision on `record:json` record it as unregistered on purpose, citing the card. The spec's retirement will move both: the parity ledger entry must then read RETIRED UPSTREAM, and the palette exclusion goes stale. |
| objectui#12333 | The installed spec is built from `2c9bf9430a`, and `1eac7ad751` is its ancestor (`merge-base --is-ancestor` exits 0). None of its pins went red in the full suite. | Not built here. The card's two remaining items (amending the #8813 pin's header, and verifying the anonymous zh-CN form) stay on the card. |

## Clause-② accept-set and type moves (`@object-ui/types`)

- **Narrows:** `page:header` `properties.showStar`. objectui's faces read the `page:header` props bag from the spec's own row by reference. So `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` now refuse `showStar` with the spec's own retirement message, at `properties.showStar`. On `next.2` both accepted it. Control: the same node without the key is accepted on both versions. No objectui renderer reads the key, since objectui#12627.
- **Widens (types only):** `SelectOptionBase`, and the field and form option types built on it, inherit the spec's optional `kind` (`open`, `won` or `lost`).
- **Read, no consumer change:** the spec retires the view form field's `visibleOn` (objectstack `105902f`). objectui's form renderer uses `visibleOn` only as its own internal channel, which the console fills from the served `visibleWhen`. The served-view path already reads `visibleWhen`.

## Deviations

- The full 16-shard run started on `2e80918` (lockfile only). While it ran, comment-only restamps and the test follows above landed in the same worktree. Because of that, the red set is quoted from a separate run on a clean `2e80918` checkout of every pin this PR touches. That run shows the 9 files and 36 tests in the table above.
- `type-check` (81/81) was last run on `1dc6351`, before the merge of `main`. After the merge, the test files `main` brought were run together with this PR's.
- `build` (43/43) was run on `2e80918`. The later commits change comments, tests and one string entry in `block-types.ts`, so it was not re-run.

## Smoke read (console from this branch, backend on 18.0.0-next.3)

The backend was HotCRM `4f82b81` with a local, unpushed override to `18.0.0-next.3` (`/api/v1/health` answered `18.0.0-next.3`). HotCRM's own metadata does not compile on `next.3`: `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts` has 44 view form field `visibleOn` keys, which the spec now refuses (objectstack `105902f`), and `objectstack dev` stops with `Compile failed`. To read the console, the spec's own remedy (`visibleOn` renamed to `visibleWhen`) was applied to the scratch copy only. Then the Leads list, a lead record page and Studio's object designer on `crm_lead` were read, with no page errors.

- Leads list: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0a6fc21b6e1145bcb05385bf6ad785f7e4c42a31/docs/design/findings/12873/leads-list-1440.png?raw=true
- Lead record page: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0a6fc21b6e1145bcb05385bf6ad785f7e4c42a31/docs/design/findings/12873/lead-record-1440.png?raw=true
- Studio object designer, `crm_lead`: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0a6fc21b6e1145bcb05385bf6ad785f7e4c42a31/docs/design/findings/12873/studio-object-designer-lead-1440.png?raw=true

The screenshots are on `claude/issue-12873-evidence` only. This branch adds no PNG.

## Test evidence (head `bc4712a`)

- **Build** (turbo, everything but the site, `--concurrency=2`): 43/43 on `2e80918`.
- **Type-check** (turbo, `--concurrency=2`): 81/81 on `2e80918`, and 81/81 on `1dc6351`. `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:e2e` and `type-check:vitest-setup` exit 0.
- **Full suite** on `next.3`: 16 shards, 5,424 files, every red in the table above. 12 shards were fully green.
- **On `bc4712a`:**
  - the 29 test files this PR touches or reaches, together with the 32 test files the merge of `main` brought: 60 passed and 1 skipped (1,405 tests passed);
  - `scripts/__tests__/` in full: 186 files passed and 2 skipped (5,620 tests).
- **Negative control:** this branch's pins with `next.2` installed (the BASE lockfile) are red, and on `next.3` they are green:
  - `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: 26;
  - the three record-block spec-parity pins: 4;
  - `select-option-spec-extension-7014`: 1;
  - `block-config`: 1;
  - `check-lockfile-integrity`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc` and `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`: red.
- **Ablations.** Each was mutated, seen red, then restored; afterwards the file hash matched `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
  - the node-level read put back on `_def.in`: 22 red;
  - the `record:json` ledger entry renamed: 2 red;
  - the record:related_list read put back on `_def.in`: 2 red;
  - `kind` dropped from the seven keys: 1 red.
- **Gates at exit 0 on `bc4712a`:**
  - lockfile and spec: `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:spec-floors`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`;
  - i18n: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`;
  - changesets: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - text: `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-json`.
- **Gates at exit 0 on the `2e80918` console build:** `check:sdui-registration-pins`, and the eager-closure budget (3149.3 KB of 3744.1 KB).
- **Lint:** eslint `--no-inline-config` over the 26 touched code files reports 0 errors.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12873-spec-next-3.md` follows the repo's pre mode (`tag: next`). It bumps the changed released packages as `minor`, never `major`. It says the console and the runner bundle `next.3`, and lists the `showStar` narrowing and the `kind` widening.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui's SDUI form option type now inherits `kind` through `SelectOptionBase`, while the spec's form view option list (`FormSelectOptionSchema`) does not take it. This is an observation; no form face was changed here.
- HotCRM's `visibleOn` keys (above) are a producer-side item for HotCRM's own `next.3` bump. It is noted here and not filed.
